acceptance_criteria.description: README.md gains an 'API' section documenting the two existing backend endpoints GET / (liveness: app name and version, no database access) and GET /api/healthz (readiness: pings PostgreSQL, returns 503 while the database is down), each with its purpose and response codes
Documentation only: no code changes, no new tests required beyond the existing suite staying green

architectural_constraints: Follow the existing documentation style of the repository
No new dependencies without an explicit operator decision
